items.heading: Start Early
items.description: The power of compounding works best when you start early. Even small amounts can grow significantly over time.

items.heading: Review Regularly
items.description: Review your goals annually and adjust your investments based on life changes and market conditions.

items.heading: Consider Inflation
items.description: Always factor in inflation when planning for long-term goals to maintain purchasing power.

items.heading: Diversify Investments
items.description: Spread your investments across different asset classes to manage risk effectively.
